# testdata/settle1d

Synthetic fixtures for the SETTLE-1d acceptance (dist/test/settle1d.sh): the values rule, the
value-bearing specifics sample, the values checklist and partial supersession. Every person,
place, date and amount here is invented. `@YEAR@`, `@WEEKDAY@` (the weekday of October 17 of
that year), `@AS_OF@`, `@CREW@`, `@BUDGET@` and `@ID@` are filled in by the test.
